definition: to become larger in size or volume
description: At a market in an old stone town on a sunny day, a laughing young woman in a mustard jacket and wide jeans pushes against a heap of colourful wet sponges bursting out of a big wooden barrel. A blue elephant-shaped sponge on top grows bigger and bigger and pushes a wooden crate off, and huge yellow sponges swell up around the barrel. Small sponges lie on the wet cobbles. Shoppers and a dog stand among fruit stalls behind, and one man films the scene with his phone.

taps.phrase: to push against a giant sponge

taps.target: the man in the denim jacket

en.question: What is the elephant sponge doing?
